contexts.text: That they had acquiesced in them, is signified by security of ease ().
To make to dwell in safety () = a state of peace.
To strip the coat from those who pass by securely () = to deprive of their spiritual truths those who live in simple good.
On this depends the public security.
Faith in instantaneous Salvation... induces security of life. Explained.
Every man who is in this security makes nothing of adultery, etc.
Charity, spiritual security, and internal rest, taken away. Signified, Explained.
In protection against the Hells... is spiritual security.
Occurs.
Faith alone... induces security, etc. TCR 182:3.
To lie down safely, none making afraid (). Explained. AE 650:58.
On those who live securely, not fearing any God. Explained. SE 2777. SE 2778.
(Such) are secure from evil Spirits. Explained.
Thou alone makest me dwell in safety... By security is signified external delight.
Security from evils and falsities. Signified.
Security to eternity = thus no infestation and fear from evils and falsities... The tents of security () = thence goods of love and worship without infestation from evils and falsities.
To pass by securely = to live well.
Those who pass by securely = all who are in truths.
Ye careless women () = the cupidities with those who have no care that the Church is laid waste.
The joyous city that dwells carelessly () = the doctrine of what is false with which they are delighted, and in which they rest.
To sit securely () = to be in confidence that their empire will endure, and that they will not perish.
The Jews... had lived securely in falsities from evil. Signified.
I will make them lie down safely () = (the cessation of) infestations from the evils and falsities which are from Hell.
Predestination, from which flows... security of life with the evil.
